positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: GCP Privacy and Security - Access Transparency

positions.title: Computer Science Instructional Laboratory (CSIL) Staff
positions.description:
-	Collaborated on reorganization and redesign of public website of lab for better user experience
-	Managed and maintained schedules through internal lab software

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-	Devised a capstone project to estimate costs for Braintree’s pairing technologies and cut spending inefficiencies; brainstormed with the team’s management, charted a full workstream for the project, and worked independently to deliver on the established goals
-	Produced script to cycle AWS EC2 instances; updating ASGs to new images without downtime
-	Developed scripting and documentation to migrate applications from an unsupported Debian OS to maintain PCI compliance; kickstarted the upgrade process for dev teams across Braintree
-	Collaborated with full-time engineers on primary-focus workstreams, contributing to the production-environment codebase

positions.title: Computer Science Research Assistant
positions.description:
-	Research team of Dr. Ravi Chugh
-	Analyzed and improved Sketch-n-Sketch (project website: ravichugh.github.io/sketch-n-sketch), a tool seeking to combine direct manipulation and programmability for .svg image creation
-	Evaluated wide survey of similar design tools, including Adobe Illustrator and P5

positions.title: Account Provisioning and Data Digitization Intern
positions.description:
-	Analyzed an existing employee computer account provisioning process and designed a new paperless workflow utilizing Jotform and Perceptive Content
-	Digitized existing documentation to ensure consistency and backwards compatibility

positions.title: Event Production Technician
positions.description:
Event Production Technician
-	Managed cameras, lights, and soundboard for performances and events
-	Performed in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment that required extended intense focus

positions.title: Student Technician (Academic and Institutional Technology Service Desk)
positions.description:
-	Provided troubleshooting to faculty, staff, and students for all college-managed technology 
-	Produced clear procedural instructions and concise technical writing
-	Maintained a high standard of customer service in person, over phone, and through email
